title: Corwin-Schultz high-low spread proxy for DRA entry admission
thesis: An otherwise valid BTC DRA entry taken after an unusually high two-day high-low spread proxy may face impaired liquidity or microstructure noise; admitting only entries whose latest normalized spread proxy is at or below its frozen prior-twenty-day median may improve equal-capital fee-adjusted risk economics.
mechanism: Aggregate the sealed H1 BTC corpus into complete UTC days, calculate the zero-floored Corwin-Schultz two-day high-low spread estimate without an overnight adjustment, divide the latest value by the ordinary median of exactly the prior twenty complete-day estimates, and admit the unchanged next-H1 DRA fill only when the ratio is at or below 1.00. Thresholds 0.80 and 1.20 are rejection-only stability neighbors.
economic_rationale: The pre-economic V2 support screen passed deterministic availability, state breadth, transition, annual concentration and nonredundancy gates versus range, realized volatility, Amihud and bipower jumpiness. That permits one matched-capital experiment but does not imply alpha; the family succeeds only if the primary improves Design and Validation total and realized PnL while preserving drawdown, underwater duration, holding and terminal inventory, and both neighbors remain economically non-worse.
